HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   D. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   C. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

6. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.

8. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.
   B. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat External Security as rumours only.
   D. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   C. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   B. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.
   C. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain External Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human developmen ts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
